claim: Runs bundled sample files in a new temporary folder, leaves the current project untouched, and prints the generated impact-card path
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:bundled-cli-demo

claim: Home and demo documentation remain available offline after the first visit
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:offline-docs

claim: Every public site route makes only same-origin runtime requests and stores no cookies, local account data, or IndexedDB data
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:no-third-party-runtime-requests

claim: Lists stale assets, sorted evidence, dependency-ordered recomputation, known minutes, and missing estimates, or reports no impact with completeness
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:core-impact-card

claim: Accepts YAML and JSON input and produces JSON or repeatably aliased redacted Markdown output
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:input-output-contract

claim: A rendered partial card repeats completeness and missing dependencies; cycles exit 2 and name their nodes
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:uncertain-lineage

claim: Reads supplied files without network libraries and never runs declared recompute commands
where: landing page, README, demo, privacy, terms
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:local-read-only-analysis
npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:mit-license

claim: The release package includes the binary built on its packaging host
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:host-platform-package

claim: Builds and installs the single executable from a clean source checkout with the documented command
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:source-install

claim: --format json and --json produce equivalent JSON output
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:format-alias

claim: Either input accepts stdin, while using stdin for both inputs is rejected
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:stdin-input

claim: Returns exit code 0 for success, 1 for file or output errors, and 2 for invalid input
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:exit-codes

claim: Root and analyze help list the available commands and options
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:help-output

claim: Rejects empty or duplicate node identifiers
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:node-id-validation

claim: Copies the sample analysis and source-install commands, announces success, and gives a manual-copy recovery when clipboard access is unavailable
where: landing page sample and install controls
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:clipboard-commands
